text: I'm always down to enjoy 74 degree weather outdoors. Searched places with outdoor seating that was also kid friendly and I came across Fire by the Monon. We went around 1:30pm on a Saturday and they could have us seated inside right away or wait for outdoor seating for 15 minutes. I obviously chose to wait. They have a waiting area outside, it's cute. We were seated outside with plenty of shade. Our server was very attentive the whole time we were there, top notch service. I had the fish tacos which were delicious!! They came with a side of rice. The rice was a little sticky, nothing that I mind, but just saying in case you do. I also had Starcut Mosa, which is like a mimosa inspired cider. Not bad but only 4.5% alcohol. Then I switched over to a Mango Voodoo, which was really good. My son had a cheeseburger and fries which he finished, so I'm assuming it was really good or else I would have heard a complaint lol. The person who I went with got the filet medium rare, it was more like medium well. I'm sure they would have gotten him a new one but he is not the type to say anything.
great food! appreciate the service! thank you! good late night food for everybody! i will try everything on the menu before the year is over with

We have gotten take out twice here since the pandemic quarantine.  Extremely accommodating owner and delicious food!  Tonight I ordered the Rigatoni alla Bascaiola.  It is a pasta dish with mushroom, peas, sweet sausage and Parmigiano in a light cream sauce. It was really wonderful.  I rarely like food that I order out, but this place really does it right.  Large menu.  Reasonable prices.
I just zipped in and grabbed some take out.  The food once again was awesome.   I got the Beef Tacos and Burritos which were both great.  Very satisfying meal. The service was awesome.
Really slow poor service and we couldn't tell the difference between blackened fish and the chicken tacos which seems to sum it up

Our son was craving pancakes when we were in town for a soccer tournament recently,  and that's how we found the Lincoln Square Pancake House. The menu is loaded with so many yummy options, it was really tough to decide what to order. We'll just have to come back again so that I can try additional selections.

I ended up ordering the French Toast, since the bread is made especially for Lincoln Square Pancake House by a local bakery, and a half portion of biscuits and gravy. My son ordered both French Toast and Pancakes, while my husband ordered a dish called the Lincoln Skillet, which was filled with hashbrowns, sausage gravy, peppers, a meat of your choice, then topped with two eggs (your choice of style). And if that isn't enough, the Lincoln Skillet also comes with your choice of pancakes, mini waffles,, French Toast, or toast. Our server was Brandy, who was very nice and patient while we asked questions and made our final decisions. 

Served with whipped cinnamon butter, the French Toast was truly the best I have ever eaten. And talk about filling! Needless to say, it's best to dine here with a completely empty stomach. The pancakes were thick and fluffy, and both my husband and son loved them. Despite being full, I also sampled a bite of hashbrowns from my husband's dish, and I loved them, particularly when topped with a little sausage gravy. My husband felt that the gravy needed a little more umpf but I liked it as is. Of course, he tends to like spicier foods than I do

Unfortunately I will not be returning. I have been previously for decent food but not this time. This time everything that could have gone wrong, did. To start with happy hour....the bartenders weren't friendly then forgot our appetizer order. When we asked about it, they said it was put in late but it was simply forgotten. When they finally put the order in, it was the incorrect item. I then tried ordering a drink...10 minutes later when I still didnt have it I asked and the bartender said he made it but forgot to give it to me. We then had restaurant week menu in the main dining. Again they brought out the wrong appetizer. It was quickly rectified however. There was another small mix up with entrees but fixed with no problem. When we tried to pay the bill we were each charged an additional 8 dollars each cause the waitress charged us for drinks we didnt order. All around horrible. Be weary!!!!

I really love Winslow's Table and loved it when it was Winslow's Home as well. My parents live right down the street and whenever I'm in town we go at least once. Food, atmosphere, etc is all great! But the main reason I'm writing this review is because Ebonie is the best server ever! She's served us a couple times now and she's so sweet and does the best job. She kills it. Always in the best mood and makes us laugh! She deserves a raise and all the tips  worth coming!
Came here with close personal friends for a Birthday Day supper and had a fabulous meal and a wonderful time.

I can't have gluten and I'm used to the Couch Tomato in Manayunk's homemade gluten free pizza dough. Bought a very expensive gf pie from Fino's and it was weird. No sauce, oily onions, peppers and sausage on a frozen, thin, store-bought gf crust. I think it was like $15. Even though I can walk here from my house, I'd much rather drive 10 mins to Manayunk for a hand made gf dough for several dollars less. Disappointing.

So my wife and I decided to give Wet Hen another try this morning as they had still owed us bacon from the previous trip. We began to order our meal of eggs Benedict and Denver omelette. I said last time we were here you guys had forgot our bacon, could we get that with our meal? Brandon said you can get anything you would like, your meal and drinks are on me! My wife and I were in shock by his generosity to redeem our previous experience. We were both incredibly impressed to have received such a positive feedback. We will definitely be back to visit soon! Thanks again Brandon, the food was delicious as always!

if there was an option to do no stars i would. don't go to this taco bell ever it's worth the drive to go somewhere else. every worker there is super unprofessional, laughing over the speaker and being extremely rude to you for no reason. also with the covid-19 virus employees are supposed to be wearing gloves and face masks and handing you the bag on a tray. this one doesn't.

Condado's gets four stars from me.  The reason it doesn't deserve a five is that we had been seated for 10 minutes before someone served us.  I understand it was a Saturday night, but that is still frustrating.  The atmosphere is cool here.  If you're looking for a night out in Broad Ripple with young friends, this place is great.  The queso is a little liquid-y for me, but to each their own.  There are plenty of TVs to watch sports, which was definitely a plus because both Butler and the Pacers were playing while I was there. Broad Ripple parking is always tough, so be aware of that.  Food was excellent. I like their chips.

To begin with, the staff is extremely rude. In person and over the phone. Called and ordered, wasn't until I went to pick the food up that I was made aware of the fact that they had no sides available until after 5. Which is ridiculous considering they open up at 11am. The food is inconsistent. Sides are bland, and the meat overcooked. Not to mention the takeout is poorly wrapped and always messy. Wouldn't recommend.

Having a hard time understanding how 1 cup of rice (.10?) and 1 cup of curry costs $12+tax. Underwhelmed to say the least, and the curry is average - a little too sweet. Maybe if they doubled down on their portions this meal might be acceptable. Still hungry.

We had not been in years and went after being invited by some friends. I'm glad we went bacThe service was excellent. The food was good. The only complaint was that the swordfish was dry. We liked the atmosphere and enjoyed ourselves.

Yes ma'am....Snapper's is slaying the seafood game with freshness and variety...except the crablegs...don't order those! Now do not come here without your pockets laced to spend because the prices are not cheap but the love and care in your food prep is worth it. This visit consisted of Crab Cake, Stuffed Grouper, Coconut Pecan Crust Mahi Mahi, Crablegs, and a nice Cider.
The fish plates offered great flavors
and were ample to share. The crab cake was crispy on the outside and soft in the middle and has plenty of crab meat to give it an official stamp of approval. Now those crab legs were very bland, skinny and old. They really shouldn't have served them just based on appearance. Your meal will come with a delicious salad that has an amazing special dressing and they served these flatbread crackers with a spicy hummus that is well worth the snacking before a meal!

Last night we had our daughter's wedding reception dinner @ PBG for about 65 people. We had probably the best party experience we've ever had. Their staff arranged tables for us with reserved signs, and were able to manage producing 65 meals promptly and perfectly! As I walked around talking to guests, almost every guest (many from out of town) raved about the quality of the food. Obviously, the venue couldn't be better... as there is plenty of room for a big party. It felt private without being too secluded. I would definitely recommend PBG for hosting a large party. The staff is amazing... helpful and happy. 
Thanks Will and the PBG team for making our party a great one!

Absolutely disgusting. Watched the kitchen staff make my pasta in a microwave, tasted like a premade package from Walmart. Found a huge hair in my food did not offer me a discount. Absolutely terrible do not eat here.
Very tasty hot & sour soup! Clean, fresh flavors with great variety! Great that you can choose white, brown rice or noodles.
Employs bartenders that are anti American and Anti military.  Take my money elsewhere. Mother of an army soldier.
Small local sushi place. We ordered miso soup, crab rangoon, a crazy Mexican roll and a caterpillar roll. Everything was fresh, hot and delicious. We will be back to try a few others.

outstanding food, service, portions, and pricing, can't believe how many times we drove past this place without a second look, we were missing out, I would give an extra star if this site would let me !!

Finally a more authentic Mexican restaurant in town. Sure they got tacos and burritos but let us be real. Who doesn't? Needless to say, I skip the usual Mexican fare. I went straight for the seafood. I got Aquachiles Shrimp and there were the best and spiciest I ever had. Well technically tied with Taco Jalisco of the North Valleys and it made sense since this place is owned by his brother and sister in law. It packed some heat so make sure you're ready for it. I also went for the Carpaccio Tuna which wasn't the traditional in a sense since the fish was slice thicker than normal. The presentation was nice and the method of eating it was interesting to say the least. It's served with a plain saline cracker and mustard but it worked. Definitely tasted better with the condiments than without them. My wife had the Huachinango aka Red Snapper deep fried and it was fried perfect with the white flesh still moist and not over cooked. They just opened so food took a little bit to come out, so if you're in a hurry, I suggest you pass and wait for a day you got time for a cerveza and good food.

This place is so great! The bartenders are amazing and so friendly. Every drink was delicious! The ambiance is fantastic too. Great place to have a drink and the food is great too. If your Reading this just go right now!

Great reason to visit New Orleans East. This restaurant is great for dine in and carry out. Deanie's offer good, consistent, and affordable food. They also give generous portions. 

I recently went here with my friend. I got the breaded veal, macaroni and cheese, squash, and salad all for $11.95. The entire meal was good and I had plenty left to take home. The macaroni and cheese was the standout dish for me, super cheesy and tasty. My friend got the bang bang shrimp wrap with twisty fries all for $11.95, she was thoroughly pleased with the meal.  Our entire meal was only $31.45, now that's a deal! 

I definitely recommend this restaurant. Good location (on Haynes Blvd) and plenty of parking.

Long time since we've been here, so we were torn on what to have for lunch so opted to come here to give another try.  Menu changed a bit - don't recall pad thai being on there before, so my husband ordered that.  I ordered the honey chicken with fried rice.  We also ordered the wonton soup (cup).  You order your food at the counter, they give you a number and you take it to a table where someone delivers your food.  There are utensils and napkins as well as to-go containers available near the soda fountain area.  The food was prompt in coming out and hot!  Indicating it was cooked fresh.  My honey chicken and fried rice were good, a little too much breading on the honey chicken but it tasted better than my husband's pad thai, which lacked spice and flavor.  Overall you get alot food for the price and we ended up taking some of our dishes home.  Note, the fried rice and pad thai do have beansprouts in them just in case you are not a fan of those then ask to remove when ordering.  I totally forgot but the beansprout portions were not overboard so I was actually ok.  The dining area could be a bit cleaner -- tables need wiping down and seating as well.  The booth we sat in had a broken side but given the fact that seating was limited when we went, we just stayed there.  The wonton soup was ok as well -- cup portion is quite small and the wontons that are in the soup are tiny, but overall taste was ok.

I will try this place again next time I pickup someone at the airport.  I must have hit it on a bad day, as both the Nanas tacos AND the beef rolled tacos and the beans had zero flavor, not even salt.  Loved the queso  sauce on the rolled tacos, though. Based on the reviews, I have to think this was a one off.  I did love how the items were prepared.  Rolled tacos nice and crunchy, with substantial filling, just no flavor.  Same with tacos.
Some of the best sushi ive had in reno. Super fresh, quality fish and great service. 10/10

Used to love this place. Was my go to for brining out of town guest. I am not sure if it is under new management or I just came on a bad day but my food was cold and the service was slow. It wasn't a very crowded night so I am not sure. They also recently switched the menu and I miss there old one! Hope they fix it!
Dryest bbq I ever had. Wouldn't recommend. Did not reach its potential. Rather go to chain restaurant

This place is amazing for brunch. 

I got the croque madame and it was delicious. Our table shared the bread platter, which came with a variety of sliced breads with different spreads (butter, peanut butter, jam, etc.). The service was fantastic - very attentive - and the food came out quick. We were a little late to our reservation (about 10 minutes) and they still honored it, even though it was a busy Saturday morning. My only caveat is that it was very busy and loud in there, so I felt like I had to yell to speak and I couldn't even hear my mother talk from across the table. But a little noise won't bother me enough to take any stars away from this wonderful, cute and fantastic establishment.

My first visit here ever. I got a cheese calzone. It looked a little odd, but it tasted OK. The crust was very good. They skipped on the trees. They put sauce inside the calzone. I did not like that the calzone was on wax paper, as it tended to stick to the food.It was pricey for what it was. But, I would try this restaurant again because I want to check out the pizza. 

Update: After thinking about it for a day, as I reviewed this is a 3 1/2 star restaurant, I'll increase it to 4 star pending my next visit.
Cheese steaks were decent as the price wasn't as bad as Steve's but the place could use a cleaning. It wasn't so dirty that would make me leave but it needs some elbow grease.

My husband had I were looking forward to having the rib special they offer on Monday nights.  We have always enjoyed them and the price. We haven't been in awhile and we went tonight.  The price is still good but the quality wasn't like they have been in the past.  They were smaller and less meatier. The baked potatoes used to be good size but small tonight.  My ribs were over done to the point they were dry and I  had burnt areas which wasn't pleasant tasting. The waitress never asked how our food was. We ordered double butter for the potatoes and didn't get. When my husband asked her for more she just brought one butter. Potatoes were dry. We use to love the bake potatoes there. 
When I was able to get her attention again I let her know the ribs were on the overdone side and dry and asked for bbq sauce to put on, she didn't even care and walked away and came back with the bbq and dropped it off. The server wasn't attentive. It was a disappointing night. We were not satisfied.
I couldn't love their food more than I do. Every time I go in I expect to be treated like family because that's what we are, family! The crispy eggplant and curries are my favorites, spicy!

It is difficult to enjoy the food when the service is so terrible. We had reservations and so we are confident that we were not "squeezed in" on the busy (but certainly not full house) night that we were there. 

Our waiter, Jeff (or Jeffrey) was totally absent during our visit after we placed our orders. And let me say that the long list of specials was recited with no prices. In each case when we inquired about price our waiter said that he did not know the price but quoted a figure and always said dismissively, "or within two dollars of that." This was so unprofessional. 

An empty place setting was not cleared when we were seated. We never had our appetizer plates cleared. In fact, when our main courses arrived there was lots of scrambling to find room and while WE were trying to stack the dirty plates we were being loudly cautioned about how hot the incoming plates were. Our water glasses were never refilled (and we had to ask twice for water at the start). We were not asked if we would like additional wine or another cocktail. 

It is a discredit to the restaurant that such an arrogant and inept waiter remains an employee there. This was a very disappointing experience.
Dinner was good. Service good except for hostess. She made a rude comment that we were 10 minutes late for our reservation but we passed empty tables,  strange,

You order your food inside at a bar that has nothing but barstools. I don't like bar stools because I'm short and climbing is annoying. Also I've been to bars like that at least 4 or 5 tables and regular chairs.

You have to order your drink from the bar, which is new to me. Most bars that I've been to have you order your food and drinks at the same location. What's even dumber is the fact that I got carded while buying a coke. Didn't know non alcoholic Coke products required to get carded.

I sit outside because it's the only area with chairs and I'm kind of annoyed with that because I didn't want to eat in the heat. I wanted to eat indoors.

My wings and waffle fries are good. The wings have just the right amount of sauce and the fries are cooked well. I just wish I didn't have to scarf it down quickly so that the flies wouldn't get to it. If you like the bar scene then this place is for you. The food is good but not worth eating outside and being attacked by flies.

I never knew Weber Grill had a bar and restaurant. So I had to try it. I order a very tasty and juicy strip. Cooked to perfection. The asparagus was little over cooked and for myself was little too burnt. I wish i got to try a cooking class but only weekends. Unless you have a private group. But that's allot of places...

I went online to order delivery. I spent over 40 minutes getting kicked out of their apps! I called the restaurant, was put immediately on hold(the phone put down by giggling manager who I could hear joking about not having potatoes.) She picked up the phone and continued to talk to staff, other customers...when I did get her attention and told her the issue I did not even finish my sentence before she interrupted me! "Oh I know the app is down! I have heard it ALL DAY*! (Laughs) ALL DAY! But that isn't this locations fault. We don't do the online (program). Did you want to order?" (*I cut the repeats of this down) I asked about delivery... I did not understand a word she said until the third time she said it. "You have to order from Uber eats or Yelp! We don't have anything to do with delivery!" I told her I tried that... she said again, "Well we don't have anything to do with that.." I just stopped her. "Never mind." The happiest she sounded, "Ok! "
I get how right now sucks! I worked in retail- I understand working with the public... BUT this manager should not even be working at Kmart! Listen to customer, verify you heard, ACT like they are important even if you cannot fix issues! The $100+ order is GONE! I am trying to support local restaurants now- spending a lot more than I should. I appreciate the people who are out doing anything now. But this was so RUDE, I was bothering them? 
********
UPDATE TO THE *UPDATE- - Of course I posted this update and THEN I GET AN EMAIL!

BBQ place that don't like giving out bbq sauce. Your order will come either with no sauce you a little bit of bbq sauce. Employees that work here will give you an attitude if you ask for extra sauce which they also charge you.

This is my new favorite bbq place! They have vegetarian barbecue using jackfruit which is a must have! Their sides are great especially the corn bread. The sweet tea was great southern style tea. I've heard raving reviews from family and it lived up to it. The staff was helpful and patient. The restaurant was kept clean and organized. The prices are reasonable.
Classic Italian food that is above and beyond all those chain restaurants. So good! It is tucked away in a strip mall but it is stand out GREAT.

First of all, I don't know where to start. Our waitress was Katy, and she broke down the entire menu because it was our first time. We heard about the fried chicken mac n cheese, so we got that along with the Blackened Shrimp Po Boy, Sweet Potato Bake, & Fries. Let me tell you this was INCREDIBLE. The service was the best i've had in Indianapolis since living here so far. Katy was my favorite waitress ever and the amazing food was just a bonus for the experience. If I could rate this place higher I would, absolutely I'll be back. on my mama

Food was lackluster, had the Chicken Tika Marsala, chicken was dry and sauce was bland even after ordering medium. For $11.99 I figured I would've gotten more than four little nuggets of chicken, but no, that was it. The place was completely empty when we arrivied but more customers came in as we were eating. You would think they didnt know that we were in the middle of a pandemic as they seated people in the booths on either side of us. The restaurant had plenty of seating to space people out but social distancing doesn't exist here. Won't be coming back.

My husband and I had Jane G's cater our pre-wedding event and I am truly disappointed. We've been big fans of Jane G's (weekly meals, guest visits, etc.) prior to our wedding, however after the event we can't see ourselves ever going back. We were so excited to share our love for Jane Gs' dan dan noodles, dry rub chicken, shrimp, etc with our friends and family. It's one of our favorite Asian restaurants in the city.
The food arrived to the venue and the Jane G's staff said the food would remain warm for two hours without chafing dishes. As one could imagine, the food was cold within 30 minutes and almost all of our guests had a cold dinner. Jane G's single-handedly ruined our event. Lucky for us, this was one of many events of our wedding celebration so we were able to salvage the weekend. I hope that no one allows Jane G's to ruin their event.

It may be a chain, but we always have a great experience when visiting. We always sit at the bar and are met with friendly staff who are efficient at what they do while being friendly. 
Their wings are some of the best we've had locally. 

Their deep dish pizza is sublime and has the most buttery crust. My husband and I usually order the medium and have plenty to take home. The shaved Canadian bacon is an incredible topping.

This is my favorite hot chicken of all time. The portions are large, the prices are great, and the dry rub is perfect. Some places advertise their their hot chicken is hot, but I am left wondering where the spice is - but this is not the case with Slow Burn. Every other hot chicken place I've tried after is disappointing now.

Still after a week waiting for them to call me In hopes they resolved my issue. Constantly calling them and just keep getting the same answer. "Ill call you back" Been a week now without any updates no call and no help. What kind of team is this if they can't give one call telling me they're working on it. The guy i called wesnesday said he'd call on Thursday its Monday now called again and still nothing. I have been more then patient with the staff but if i need to result in a lawer to resolve the issue with the officer that night i will.

If you love elote, you must try Empire's elote pizza. I used to get it regularly when I worked downtown, but forgot how good it was until I ordered delivery recently. It might be my favorite pizza flavor of all time!!

If this review was based solely on food, it would probably be a 3. I just found the fish to be bland and not very flavorful. The clam chowder was thick with ingredients but the actual soup itself was very watery, as if there wasn't any roux. However, the restaurant is very cute as it's an old shed and sits right on the water. Our server was very friendly and the food was fast. All seating is outdoor so keep that in mind for weather.

Where do I start?? We were greeted promptly. We had reservations. A group of 4. As three of us wanted a chardonnay, we ordered a bottle. The other wanted a Riesling, but they didn't have any. So she ordered a Moscato. Her wine was brought promptly. We were brought a bottle in the bucket and were told that the wine was warm to let it sit for a bit to get cold! Really!!! Well that didn't sit well with my husband, so he grabbed another server and was asking why we could not get a cold bottle of wine, when our server came over and said let me pour your wine. Warm Chardonnay Really!!! We were told they had no cold Chardonnay!! Really!! A restaurant such as yours and you don't keep some cold!!! So now we have chosen to put ice cubes in our wine to make it cold!! Maybe we should have gotten up at this point and left. But no, we were there to celebrate a birthday of my deceased father-in-law's birthday, as he came here every year for his birthday for many years. Did I tell you that my 95 yoa mother-in-law, who is the spouse of said father-in-law, was one of our group? She also accompanied him on his visits there. So it was special for her to visit on this occasion as well.
Ok so now we get our bread. Nice warm loaf which was already seasoned with garlic butter. So we were chatting and enjoying our selves when we ask for another bread to go with our meal. Well I'm not sure if it came from another kitchen in the place, but this bread was cold with no seasoning. Oh did I mention they br

To start off wish I could give this restaurant a zero start instead of a one star. Spent $40 on a meal that was not cooked as promised. The fries were in seasoned and the lemon pepper wings were basically unseasoned wings. If I'm lying this kind of money for food, I expect everything to reach expectation and unfortunately, they did not. Would love to talk to who ever the manager is at this location because this is absolutely unacceptable.
Food is good  but the wait time is ridiculous. I waited over 2 hours the last 2X just for 2 pizzas and wings

since becoming a vegetarian, my biggest struggle is being able to find a good veggie hot dog. that is up until i found the 4th ave deli! i can't believe how amazing the dogs were here, and it's so incredible that you can order any of the menu options as vegetarian. highly recommend!!

While my kids and I really enjoy this place for a quick and delicious meal, their order accuracy is frequently poor. It seems like every other drive through order is either wrong or missing items. 

The kids get all excited about Chik Fil A and by the time you get home and see the wrong order, everyone is bummed out. Then what are you going to do? Drive back and wait for a replacement? Or spend 10 minutes on the phone? Neither option is very fun or practical and what is supposed to be a big convenience is now a pain. 

Ordering in store is problematic at times too. For example, I recently ordered a Cobb Salad with grilled nuggets and got a Market Salad with cold chicken. When I mentioned it, they then gave me a sad looking Southwest Salad with grilled nuggets. By the way, neither of these is a Cobb Salad with grilled nuggets, which doesn't seem to be that complicated of an order. Nonetheless, the staff couldn't seem to get it right. 

The guys and girls that work here are actually quite nice and the company is very customer oriented, so I'm not understanding the disconnect between all that good stuff and the low accuracy order fulfillment. Whatever the reason may be, it certainly makes us stop by less than we have in the past.
Had a few casuals here on a Friday night. Massive indoor dining space. I find the menu to be a bit plain but decent nonetheless. They serve some local beers that I enjoyed at about $6 each.

As I'm writing this review I just got seated after 25 mins wait after the initial estimated 3 mins that the hostess told us. We came in a Friday night so I understand that we have to wait without an RSVP.
There were a party of two came after us but with RSVP so of course they got seated first and that's understandable. Then 2 tables are available then a party of 4 (they are just walk-ins) came in way after us like (15 mins). 
These ppl got taken right away to the table that supposed to be ours. Just because they are a bigger group. I would have left right there but because I drove 50 mins to try out this place and already wasted 1.5 hours. So we stocked around.

I've been here several times now and it is by far my favorite sushi place in Reno!  This visit was during the covid19 quarantine so takeout was the only option. To my surprise everything was just as fresh and delicious. We ordered a spicy tuna, California, Mermaid and Ceviche roll. I highly recommend the Ceviche which has a thin lemon slice topped with red onion and jalapeños!  We also got a tuna poke bowl and everything was super fresh.  I'm going to have a hard time trying any other place.

Perfect Sunday brunch place. Relaxing atmosphere and tasty light brunch. Pacing of the food was a bit off but understandable as the kitchen is on the smaller side. Excellent wine selection. Highly recommend.

We just celebrated our anniversary at Firebirds and have to give a thumbs up to the manager, Rich and our server Alisah !
It was a very busy night and Rich took time to come to our table and wish us a Happy Anniversary and chat a bit . We could observe the way the manager and staff worked together to handle a very busy dinner rush . The service was great as well as our dinners . A delicious complementary cheesecake dessert to make it a perfect celebratIon for our anniversary.
We highly recommend Firebirds in Tucson.
Just had lunch here and it was so yummy! Our waitress was awesome and the atmosphere was great. We will definitely be back!!

My boyfriend and I took a spontaneous trip to Reno and decided to stay at the Silver Legacy which I now realize was a big mistake. 

We were there for one night and managed to be bitten by bed bugs all over our bodies. 

Now I'm paranoid if I may have brought some of the bugs back with me. 

The hotel itself was not very clean and was outdated so it's no surprise they have a bed bug infestation.

Visited The Couch Tomato Bistro for the first time last night on a last minute date with my husband we were seated right away and the service was great. We had a cheese tray that was awesome, the complimentary tomato soup was perfect, and my husband had a delicious burger. Overall super happy with our visit. They had a great beer list too with some really good tasting ipa's. We will definitely be back!

Great place to eat!! The food was good. I got the burger, my hubby got the red beans and rice, and my daughter got the shrimp po boy. All of them taste good. If/when we ever come back to New Orleans we will be back there again. The waiter was fantastic!!
Ridicously slow kitchen! Becoming habitually slow! This used to be our favorite  choice but this service has changed our opinion

Went on a Saturday night and got seated in ~20 minutes. The food is about what you would expect for pub style food, but the prices are reasonable and service was great. Our food arrived in a reasonable amount of time and our server Amy was so sweet. The outdoor dining area is also well lit and they have some heat lamps to keep customers warm. Glad to see them doing well during these challenging times!

The arepas are so good that I came for dinner twice during my 2 week stay in NOLA. Personally had the Carnicera arepas and tres leches both times (loved it so much that I didn't wanna try anything else).
I love this place! The coffees are fantastic, the food is wonderful and the people are super nice! Highly recommend!

If you love super long waits, then this place is for you!  Came in on a Saturday for a quick brunch bite.  I ordered the Chicken and Waffle, and then waited for over an hour before food made it to the table.  

The food was cold and void of anything tasting like chicken and waffles. Actually had to ask for a side of maple syrup, which seemed odd to the server. 

In my hour and half quick bite experience, the server came back once to offer more water while enjoying my dried out waffle. 

Overall will not return, service was bad and food was worse!  Hopefully they can turn it around.

This is the worst chick fil a I have been too, which isn't too bad to say. They just have mediocre slow service, the food is still good but they offer things on the online menu that aren't available in store(I.e. tortilla soup)  I ordered it for pick up and waited 20 minutes only to be told it's not available and he didn't even offer me compensation or anything he gave me a free chicken nugget which is half the price of the bowl of tortilla soup I ordered!! I go to chick fil a a lot in South Carolina and the only bad experiences I've ever had at a chick fil a are here in Tucson! I also ordered an iced coffee recently and it tasted so bitter like it had been over brewed. It was so gross waste of $3! Really disappointing

Solid for years!
Awesome guacamole, salsa bar, margaritas and menu specials that always bring a twist for the unsuspecting locals that let a few months pass before returning for a pleasant meal. 

Our family has been coming here for over 7 years - it's never ranked below a very satisfactory experience - frankly it's often an overindulgence that we reflect back on days later as one of our best meals we had while visiting the area. 

We have vegans, vegetarians, pescatarians and hard core carnivores in our group - non of us ever leave disappointed!!

They just celebrated their 15 year anniversary - I'm sure they're going to be here another 30 if they keep up their game!

Wasn't great but wasn't terrible. I didn't think I got the amount of food that it was priced for. The service was slow. The vegetable roll and vegetable tempura were both $7.50. I enjoyed the vibe of the restaurant and it was clean.
We love this place. Always friendly and food is always good. My wife and I eat lunch here about twice a month when our schedules allow.

My wife and I chose this place due to hearing about it over the years.  We were attending a play in area and decided to give it a try.  We split the Caesar Salad for starters.  The size was perfect for sharing.  I loved their style of dressing...a little light than the traditional Caesar type with marvelous flavor.  The croutons were to die for!  For the entree, we split the Spinach Manicotti.  They have an amazing red sauce for this dish that stands apart with just a touch of sweetness.  For dessert, we got the  raspberry cheesecake.  It was a great finish to a fine meal topped with their amazing coffee (house blend).  Nice decor with a friendly atmosphere.  Our server, Brooke, was fantastic:  friendly, informative, engaging.  We plan on visiting again in the near future.

I can't believe it took me so long to try this place! I feel like a fool. I loved the grilled steak bowl but the karaage (Japanese fried chicken) is where it's at. The flavors are so unique. Definitely want to try the Seoul Burger next time!
Waited over an hour for 3 drinks to be delivered. They never arrived.  We live for blocks away.
22 minute wait for 10 stale nuggets and a drink because they didn't want to deliver curbside

I overall had a pretty good experience at Gray and Dudley. I was pleasantly surprised when I was seated to a quiet, more intimate restaurant than what I expected out of a hotel restaurant right off of Broadway. Our waitress Mary Grace was incredible- she had perfect etiquette. 

The food itself also was pretty good. Three of us split fried rice, cucumber salad, ribs, scallops, and chicken. The rice and scallops were great, the others were good but nothing super special. 

The service -- aside from Mary Grace's hospitality - was the issue. For an 8:30 reservation on a Friday night, you would expect the restaurant to have been prepared. First, we ordered a glass of sauvignon blanc (there was only one kind by the glass). They ran out of the sauvignon blanc and brought us back a "similar" tasting wine which tasted very different from a SB. 

Slightly discouraged, we ordered appetizers. Our waitress talked up one appetizer so we were really excited about ordering it. We put in our order of appetizers and entrees, and she came back to tell us that there was none of that appetizer left. Again discouraged, we ordered a different starter, but all of the ones that she suggested were "small". 

After finally putting in the order after about 30 minutes of trying to figure out food/drink orders, the food came out extremely slow. No one came to check on us while there were probably 20+ minutes between appetizers and entree's. 

We ended up leaving happily because the food itself was good,

Brutal. Nothing better to say- 

- waited 1 hour 15 minutes for a table we reserved. 
- was told we'd be given small plates at the table to compensate for the wait
- had to ask for them to do what they said they would do, bring out the small plates - to which they not only balked, but brought out a cold Margherita pizza in its stead. 
- food was mixed - some good main plates. The desserts were a full blown mess, served sloppy and without much flavor. Avoid the chocolate panacotta - horrible. 
- the service was probably the worst part of the experience. Our waitress had an attitude from the first minute she came to our table. Was trying to rush us yet was never around to get drinks refilled or tend to our needs. She knew little of the menu and was snippy when one guest asked about an unlisted item, saying that if you don't see it then it's not there. 

Never. Ever. Again.

I was so excited to receive my food I forgot to take a picture. This place is AWESOME! The food is always freshly cooked and the serving sizes are exactly what you need. The pancakes are nice, fluffy and tasty too. The staff is always friendly and helpful. The restaurant has a nice and homey feel and staff goes out their way to make all customers feel welcomed. 

Writing this review makes me want to go back soon. If you're reading this...TRY THEM OUT! You won't be disappointed. Also, utilize the convenient drive thru. Overall, 10/10. 

One more thing, they have a banner up on their website mentioning how one of the long time servers got married. So they shut down for the weekend to celebrate. That really moved me, in this day & age all companies are looking to generate profits especially during the pandemic. For Nashville Biscuit House to shut down & lose money to celebrate a major life event of one of the staff is truly heartwarming. They truly value their workers. That makes me want to support them even harder .

I've always really enjoyed Salty Cowboy. It's one of those places I rarely go-to, because I'm never in the Zionsville area, but it's so worth the trip. The place itself it's small, and has a little parking lot but is almost always full. There's some street parking in front, but don't be surprised if you have to park a couple blocks away. The place always has a wait. This is not a place I'd suggest bringing a large group too. They have a nice patio space for you to hang out with a margarita until your table is ready. I'd suggest ordering the trailer park appetizer with guacamole, salsa and guacamole. What I love about this place is they make their guac table side! Their coconut margarita is one of my favorites.
My husband and I went in awhile back and enjoyed a wonderful evening out for dinner here. The steak melted in my mouth and the service was over the top amazing cant wait for date night here again!

We had a party of 4 for a birthday and we had a great time. Our server was attentive and on point. The Camaro and veggie tempura was good and the tumpura califlower was the bomb and it b had VA little kick. The entrees were good as well.

I love noodled& company so much, i ordered online and it came right to my doorstep. But I was a little confused because it gave me three rice crispy treats when I thought I ordered one. Anyways it was really good

Hands down the best cake donut ever made. I buy the glazed Apple Cider cake donut and its "heavy". Heavy because it's moist and loaded with flavor. I don't even mind that I h e to break pieces off it because it's so moist it falls apart when you try to eat it like a standard donut.

This place sucks and I've only been here two days so far. 

First of all, HORRIBLY overpriced. Every single thing is insane. The vending machine sodas are $3 each! The breakfast restaurant cost $50 for breakfast for me and my mom: French toast and bacon for me, eggs and toast for my mom.  FIFTY DOLLARS. The service at the restaurants is terrible and slow as well. 

The worst of the worst though has to be BUGS. the first room we were in had tons of ants. We complained and were moved a few doors down. Within minutes found a spider on my moms pillow. Not to mention both rooms were missing things: room service menu, trash cans, do not disturb sign. It's insane. 

This place should not not NOT be a 4 star hotel.

Let me first preface this review by saying that I take no joy in writing negative comments for any establishment. I'm just giving my honest opinion, and I apologize in advance if I offend the owner or their staff. I mean no ill will, and hope that perhaps my criticism's can be used in a positive manner. 
     With that said, I was not a fan of the slice of pizza I was served. The sauce seemed straight out of a can and had a really metallic taste to it, and the cheese was just really bland. The crust wasn't to bad, but it was rather doughy and didn't have much of a crisp to it. I think it's fair to say that perhaps I just caught them at a bad time, as they do have a pretty good reputation on YELP, and you don't maintain 4 stars by luck. They are located right in the heart of downtown Saint Petersburg, so I'm sure they are very busy, especially on the weekend which is when I visited. Keeping that in mind, if they make 200 pizzas a day there's always that possibility to make 1 or 2 bad pie's, and maybe I just happened to get one of those (bad timing). On the other hand, this might be a case of a "drunk pizza" establishment (the nickname given to a place that is frequented by college students and the like late night after getting out of the bars), where anything tastes great at 2am, especially a lackluster pizza. 
     Shade aside, I really want to give this place the benefit of the doubt, so I will definitely be returning to do a follow up review. Again, I think I just caught th
We had a blast at Shrimpys!! Great service, live music, and amazing food!! Had the Captains platter with three different types of seafood- all awesome! House wine was GREAT!!!

Rude and unprofessional. Can't Handel the orders that the get in a reasonable amount of time. When I asked for my order the lady said that it was just waiting on the naan bread after I sat there for 15 almost 20 minutes and found out another lady had been waiting for an hour and 15 minutes for her order I asked how long it would be and she replied all of the orders needed naan bread probably they are just liars and treat you like poo. Asked how long it would be until my order was ready and he told me that it will be ready when it's ready. I told him that he was being unprofessional and that he needed to give me a time once I put him in his place he told me it would be 5 to 7 minutes rude rude rude do not give them your business they do not deserve it.

Really nice. Love their tea selections and that I can sit there with a big pot of hot tea and just enjoy the day. A little reminder of some time in France. Peaceful. Sometimes the deserts are too dry.
Absolutely the best Italian restaurant I have been to in philly. The nicest owners very good prices everything is homemade. The vodka sauce was out of this world. Will deff be bac.
The noodle soup was good and the pig ear combo were a must try! The establishment is very clean which is a pleasant surprise!!

I had a really great experience here. I never get steak unless I'm at a steakhouse because I am very particular with how my steak is cooked. I had one of the best New York strips from his place. It had Gorgonzola butter and melted in your mouth. The server was very nice and on point. I will be back !!
The shrimp was really good too.
This place was amazing! I had the Hot Mess  which is a scrambled egg bowl with popcorn chicken, potato cakes, & cheese. I got the BBQ sauce on the side and no hot sauce. Great place

I was in the mood for Thai food and my friend suggested this place. We got 2 lunch specials. The soup that came with was delicious,  full of veggies also. The curry and noodle dishes were very good as well. Will definitely come back to try other dishes. Service was quick and friendly as well!

I used to enjoy coming here, there were a few servers who made it enjoyable. I came in the other night and someone was complaining about being there longer than they were supposed to, saying they wouldn't wait another table. I saw a young cook who looked to be in training reach into a bin and put food in his mouth, with his cooking gloves on that weren't changed after. I felt like saying something but it was before my food was cooked. I say cooked but it must not have been cooked well enough because I spent the last 24 hours with food poisoning.

Pretty amazing place I would have to say. Noticed it while I was wondering around the neighborhood and always wanted to try it. So me and a friend decided to go at happy hour so we can try a bunch of their food but at a smaller portion size and a little bit of a smaller price. 

One thing I wish they would have asked is if we wanted to go to the bar or sit in the regular restaurant. Unfortunately someone new would not know that happy hour is only served in the bar area. 

So that being said, the gal was seating us at the regular dining and I asked her if they serve the happy hour menu here and she said that is only in the bar area. 

Only reason I knew was reading another review on yelp when I was just seeing what they were all about. 

I've been here a good handful of times now. They're vanilla old fashion has been my go to drink lately. They also have a really tasty jalapeño martini. 

Their mussels are delicious, probably my favorite so far that I have tasted in the menu. Although I've ordered the regular size and the happy hour size and it did not differ much which was disappointing. The muscles were also very small. I feel if they are that small to maybe give a little bit more. 

By any means am I stingy when it comes to food. I will spend a pretty penny on food if it's worth the price, but you have to be consistent with the serving sizes. Right? 

Anyway, the mini beef Wellington bites were very good and had a good balance between the pasty puff and the filling, the pra

Their food is always fresh and delicious.  Fair warning, unless you're a big eater, their portions are large enough for 2 ppl to share, which my husband and I frequently do when ordering for take out.
Brown folks beware is all I can say; the customer service is way different at this place.

What an awesome place to go grab a bite! Always super clean, the staff has always been very friendly, and the food is fresh and consistent
 Highly recommend!

I need to find a go to Thai place near by job in NPR so I tried this place. I ordered the red curry for take out and had to wait a while once I got there. 

The curry was good, but not as spicy as I like. I ordered Hot to see what their hot was like and clearly I am going to need Thai hot.

I'll try it again and see if I can give a more complete review. They also have sushi so next time I may have to try their sushi.

This is the place to be on Fulton Alley. They give amazing service, the quality is amazing, and they're food is outstanding. We went with friends for a night out after a long week and I got the ribeye. Recommended by our amazing server Sierra. The chef, Neph, really knows what she's doing. The manager Damien has some has some amazing people working there. We will definitely be back soon for more. Highly recommend this place! Cheers!
Tried the Molkajete Mixto. The three salsa sauce was tremendous as was all the accompaniments. Would definitely come back.

I decided to stop in on a Sunday evening. I was impressed, sat at the bar ordered one of the signature cocktails, rye, maple and bacon, yummy. I found out they carry my favorite St. George's Terroir Gin, Gin and tonics it is!!!! I had the Bahn Mi sliders, they were great!! Lucia the bartender was wonderful!!! Discovered they were hosting Drag Queen Bingo on the following Thursday supporting the Humane Society....My wife and I returned, and she discovered the bathtub cocktail, which she just adored! We played two cards a piece in the BINGO game, it was so much fun, the Drag Queens were hysterical!! We were big winners, 3 out of the 5 games!! I WON A DOG!!! My new go to fun bar, will he back for sure!!!!

Awesome replacement for Brass Tap. Decent beer selection and expanded menu for food. Tonight there was live music, not bad but not our style and a little loud.  Had the Pretzel bites , bourbon short ribs and the Asian ginger pork belly served over Mac and cheese, all outstanding!!  Plan on coming back often!!

My wife and I found Miracle on yelp and decided to try it. We arrived and were greeted very friendlily by the gentleman behind the bar and the waitress that sat us. They both had glowing personalities and were very cheerful the entire dining experience. We ordered two rolls to split and well as crab rangoon's. Everything came out fresh and beautifully plated, not to mention very well timed. To wrap up we decided to try the apple pie egg rolls. Let me tell ya.... they were fantastic and clearly made of freshly prepared ingredients, not canned pie filling. We will be back!

Look. All of our food is always really good when we go that's not the problem. I didn't see anywhere else on the receipt to go to complain so here I am. We ordered two lunch specials and two appetizers. we got the first appetizer (shrimp) and it was perfect. We then got our two lunch bowls. Yummy! Our whole dining experience was about an hour and 15 minutes. We got the dumpling appetizer after all of our food was done and we asked to cancel them. After an hour and 10 minutes of eating... The waitress Kaitlyn looked at me when I asked and said "no you can't cancel them, they're in the window" and then takes minutes to bring them to us. They were hot and looked fresh.. the part that threw me off is that when our bowls came out 30 minutes before this she told us 5 minutes for the dumplings. It took way longer than that and she was certainly not concerned that I didn't want them anymore. I felt like she basically told me it's not her problem when I told her we didn't want them. And then to get an 85 dollar check and she never offered any sort of at least discount for how long they took? Just a disappointing experience and I didn't feel like we could ask her for one because of how dismissive she was.

This is the best Japanese restaurant on whyte ave!! I live south side but go here at least once a month. I love the atmosphere, quick service and heated toilet seats in the bathrooms. My favourite appetizer is the presses pressed salmon but everything on the menu is homemade, you can't go wrong with anything! I have been coming since it first opened a few years ago!! I strongly recommend stopping in for lunch or dinner
It'd be cool if they changed their hours online to match the real closing time :) it's 8pm btw not 10pm. Would've been nice to know instead of driving all the way over here
Great Spot, You can order literally anything on the menu and it will be amazing. The food is so fresh and staff is so friendly, I would recommend stopping by and trying this place.

We've been going to Goodwood for the past five years. Never had a bad meal there. The smoked turkey breast is moist and flavorful. The pulled pork--moist! I've had the salmon which was incredible- moist and full of flavor. The burgers are cooked perfectly.. medium.  We've done take out and have had no issues with regards to the flavor, the heat of the food when we got it home. All good!  Their onion rings... TO DIE FOR.

My fiance and I LOVE Rice Thai Bistro! When we moved to Ballwin a few months ago, some friends recommended  trying it out and we can't stop ordering food!

We have tried many of the dishes, but we recommend  the pad see ewe, wonton soup, and seafood omelet. We like the pad see ewe is always very flavorful with the egg and sauce they use, however there have been times when it can be a little bit too salty or not have enough sauce so it was dry (hence why I took away a star). The wonton soup's broth is absolutely my favorite broth of all time (I order soup with almost all of my meals) and the wontons are super tasty! Finally, the seafood omelet. I try egg dishes at other restaurants and they never can come close. The way they cook it makes the eggs so fluffy! 

Additionally, their staff has always been very pleasant towards their guests. I highly recommend Rice Thai Bistro!
Love the history of this place. It feels like stepping back I time but as a foodie with much yummier choices.

My friend and I decided to get an early dinner today to celebrate my Birthday. . We ordered the shrimp scampi and a thin crust pizza. It was taking a while for our food to come out and the server stoped by to say it would be out soon. The food runner  ended up delivering 'our order' to the booth next to us. The food runner put extra shredded parmesan on the pizza  for that table. After five minutes  our server stopped by and we asked if our order would be out soon, he said he would check on it. The booth next to us flagged down their server and said they didnt order that kind of pizza, they took the pizza back to the kitchen. A few minutes later they delivered our food. They had put the pizza from the othet table back in the oven, you could see the Parmesan cheese on  on the pizza was melted, so i asked our server if this was the same pizza that sat on the  other table? He said yes, I told the server I don't want to eat  that pizza. The manager came and apologized and said a new pizza would be out in 15 minutes. About 15 minutes later the 'new' pizza came out, it was really cheesy  and the crust was burnt. I think they just added  more cheese to the pizza that they delivered to the other table. After all of this we were still charged full price for the pizza. It's against health code to serve a table food after serving to another table.

This is the first date night we have had in months. So was excited to go out. Heard great things about this place and I liked the name. Saw the cute little turtles in the glasses on yelp. I thought it was cute. We were very disappointment. Service was bad. Food was super salty.  Got the short rib. It was ok. Couldn't cut it with the knife though. The fish and chips was all salt. Hard to eat. And didn't have water to wash it down. I not recommend.

I think I have been here five times within the past month.

WHOLE30 PEOPLE, THIS IS WHERE YOU NEED TO BE!!
The restaurant is great because it's so paleo, keto, Whole30, and I think Vegan friendly as well. In St. Louis, it's one of the two restaurants that are Whole30 approved! Which is insane... 

I went here because I did Whole30 as an experiment with myself on mental strength and testing food allergies as well. I fell in love because the food that they are able to create were a lot better than the foods that I was able to make while being on Whole30. I never knew good until I came here.

If you just order the cauliflower rice, chicken, sweet potatoes, balsamic mushrooms with onions, and buffalo sauce / lemon aioli, then you are set to eat Whole30 approved food! I love it there and I practically ordered the same thing every time until the Buffalo sauce was removed off the menu recently. I'm sure they change up the menu from time to time, but they have a lot of variety that makes eating there very healthy and fun!

The smoothies without yogurt, yea they are great too! And try their juice blends too 

It's nice because the service is always fast and they deliver via Postmates and DoorDash too 

I will be back!! And I'll remember to take pics too!
Sandwiches are decent, but their breakfast food is pretty bland. Would recommend eating at the restaurant rather than ordering to-go because the food doesn't stay warm or travel well.

Been in town 6 months from Cali and this the by far the best Mexican food I have found yet. An trust me I've been trying . The Chile Colorado burrito is bomb and the street style tacos are a little larger then normal and a little crispy but still bomb. Sure they will do it regular if requested. Only complaint is the close far to early!

OK, I have admitted in the past that I am not a big Mexican food fan but my wife and father-in-law like it.  Last evening we went to Cabos for dinner to try the new place out and here are my personal thoughts.
Positives:  We were seated quickly and the service was very good.  Our waitress was Katie, a tiny, super cute lady that took very good care of us throughout our meal.  She checked on us frequently and we wanted for nothing.  She did an excellent job.  
I ordered steak fajitas, my wife ordered  Chili Verde with pork and my father-in-law ordered the tortilla soup.  My fajitas were very tasty and the portion was large.  The tortillas and the usual sides that came with my dinner were very good too.  Everything came out hot from the kitchen and the food runners were also very attentive.  I couldn't even finish all of the fajitas and packed up the remainder to take home.   My wife loved her dish and my father-in-law was very pleased also.  All things considered, it was a very good dining experience.  I would have given 4-stars if I were a Mexican food fan.  I am certain that my wife and her dad would give Cabos 4 or maybe even 5 stars.  They were quite pleased with their fare.
Negatives:  The place is very loud due to the fact that there is nothing but interior hard surfaces.  Therefore, the sound bounces off of everything in there.   The Margaritas could have a bit more tequila in them.  They were pretty mild.  
If you like Mexican food and live locally I am sure you will en

Oceana is one of the best restaurants I ate during my trip to NOLA. The wait is a little long depending on what time you go, but it is definitely WORTH IT! The service was excellent , the atmosphere was fun and welcoming, and the food was absolutely amazing! This will definitely be on my must go to list next time I'm in town

I've never dealt with such consistent poor customer service in my life. Leonardo's messes up my order at least 8/10 times. It's not that complicated, only 3 ingredients. How is it that you repeat my order to me and still get it wrong?! They NEVER apologize and they re-make it with an attitude. My family won't be eating there again. 

It's a shame because when they opened years back I was truly a fan. I'm not sure if they've changed management or what. They operate that place like they don't give a damn!

The service was great but the food was average. My waitress never let my drink get even half way down before she refilled my drink. I wish I had remembered her name to give her praise on here. Bottom line, go to Mission Barbecue instead for better food.

My favorite part of Indian is the amazing sauces but these place didn't deliver.  The dishes have the traditional ingredients but execution is disjointed. Recommend making to short drive to Taj in Nashville or House of India in Cool Springs.

April went above and beyond to help me with my take out order. April answered my three phone calls and realized I was having difficulty placing an order. (with an outside delivery company) April talked to her manager and offered to deliver the order. The order was perfect and delivered on time! Thank you, April!

I've been here a handful of times and I'm glad they've expanded! This location is only a few years old as their space was much smaller. This cafe is truly one of a kind- there are many seating options with couches and work spaces. The food is delicious and there is always something healthy! Particularly I love their salad with chickpeas, their wraps, and sweet potato hash. I adore their cakes and devoured a large section of their strawberry shortcake which a friend gifted my family for a birthday. Whether you're looking for coffee, dessert, or a lunch, this is an ideal spot to stop in. Fresh, healthy, and full of variety!
This was our first visit, and we will be back!!! The flavors were amazing! The servings were way too big!!! The patio was a nice option with this beautiful weather!
Place is a mess, every trash can was full, floors covered in dirt and food and trash on the counters!

Ordered for delivery without really knowing anything about the restaurant. Wow, was glad I did. Really good food (pad see ew with chicken), my only issue was that the spring rolls really were not hot despite this being right down the street from where I work and the delivery driver coming straight to me after picking up the food. Really looking forward to trying Thai Coconut again.
Definitely going back. Excellent food and beautiful environment. If only they served cocktails

I have been coming here regularly for over a year now and have really mixed feelings about the place. It is a nice semi-comfortable space and the people who work there are always very nice. So from that standpoint we have a winner! 

The coffee: The beans they use are pretty good for the middle of NJ, I have no complaints there. I have bought some and brewed them in a variety of ways at home. However, the coffee they serve you in the store is where it all falls apart. The quality of the espresso based drink is highly dependent on who is making it, which should not be the case. 2 out of 10 times it is a good drink. The other 8 out of 10 times it is over or under extracted with the resulting flavor issues you would expect to follow. The cold brew can be good, if they stop 'using whatever beans they have extra of' and focus on the type/profile of the bean to make an appropriate cold brew. Every now and again they use their Brazil blend which makes a great cold brew. More often they use their other blends which make an acidic cold brew thats not very good. 

The food: Baked goods are ok. Things like cakes and cookies are pretty good, all else is meh. The scones lack so much flavor and are really dry (I know scones are supposed to be dry, but these are a special kind of dry). The quiche is really disappointing and I have no idea why people keep buying it. I ordered it twice and each time it was cold in the center (once was frozen) and the crust was soaking wet and soggy after bein

We went to Shamrocks on Sunday. The service was terrible. It seemed to be poor planning on the part of whom ever does the scheduling. There were no waitresses, only the bartender. I do not believe the bartender would have even handled the bar well. 
The food was good but that took an unreasonable amount of time to come out. I wouldn't go back.

I went into the Breakfast Nook for breakfast this morning, mistake. First, the server (Maggie) tried to bring my coffee after I told her I didn't order coffee and only wanted a water. Second, I ordered 4 eggs scramble well, dry wheat toast and grits. I received 4 runny eggs, white toast dry and grits with butter. Ok, I could have sent it back, but I decided to eat it because I was hungry. The final issue, my bill was $6.69, so I pay with a $30 bill. I received $13.00 in change. Not the $13.31 I should have received, so this will be my last time eating there. The server was horrible and she apparently can't count either.

Pasta bolenese was excellent $17.00 ( nothing comes with it) bread is extra $4.00!

They offer to split the pasta for us at no charge w

We had the pineapple pizza that was good crust was a bit flavorless but otherwise the pizza was good.

6oz glass of Pinot noir was nice at $8.00.


Overall I think the place is nice but prices are on the high side!

Sever ice was a bit bumpy but since only 4 days open that is expected.

I will definitely go back and try other things.



Went back a few times since they first opened and the food has really been sub par! 

Had the 12.0" chop chop salad that was wilted and had some mystery meat chunks in it that was awful!!

I won't be back!

I ordered 3 products.  One was fine and had all the appropriate hardware.  the second item a Lilligan high cabinet was 1) missing some brackets and some wooden dowels.  My son had some extra dowels from some furniture he had bought so we put the thing about 3/4's together when I realized the legs were missing.  I called and called and called - 6x waited on customer service hold for 30+ minutes before finally hanging up.  Emailed and no help.  Finally, we got in the car and drove 35 minutes one way to the store.  they said the feet were not included even though the picture when ordering same shows them.  So I bought - for another $21 - the feet.   Drove 35 minutes back home and found (1) 1 leg was missing the hole to attach the footer (2) the feet were not correct for my cabinet.  I called Visa and contested it as I am NOT doing an hour and 10 minute drive again.  I will NEVER buy or recommend IKEA again.  Horrid customer service - in fact  saying they have customer service is laughable.  the 3rd product was a cutlery insert - size was over what it said and I returned it since I was in the store for the "feet."

Food was mediocre at best. Certainly nothing to make me go back. Everything was your typical run-of-the-mill Greek café. Grape leaves certainly are not supposed to taste like that so don't let it ruin you. Soap operas were screaming in the dining room. Very unpleasant atmosphere overall. Would not return.

The food was absolutely delicious and all of the ingredients tasted fresh. We got several different dishes and all were equally tasty. Highly recommend their fried rice. Beef and Broccoli, Orange Chicken, General Tsos, and Sweet and Sour Chicken were all good.

This place has a fabulous view and the food is phenomenal.  Island flavor food while taking in the fabulous view of the bay.  I had the chicken with flavored rice and mango salsa and it was packed full with flavor.  Drinks are great.  Service wonderful.  Will definitely return.

I really appreciate the costumer service. I didn't expect them to stay open late. I had put my order in but I showed up to the wrong location (at this point they were closed)but they were totally understanding. Burger was delicious.
Simply delicious. All the meats were tender and juicy. Good amount of smoke. I got the double wide and it was plenty to share between 2+ people.

Have been going to Gray's since 1974. How is that possible? Consistently superb food and atmosphere.  Each person can find something they like, and as much or as little as you want. Keep on "continuously serving" Gray's!

So surprised by the quality of the sushi here! I was not expecting when moving to Boise that I would find a place with good sushi...it was hard enough to come by in Austin, a foodie Mecca. The ramen wasn't my favorite but you CANNOT go wrong with the sushi here.

I have been patiently waiting for this location to open! Avon has been in desperate need for a new coffee place for quite some time now so I was really excited to hear about this place opening! I decided to go on opening day, so even though the line was long, I went in expecting this and knew I'd probably have to wait. Honestly, the friendly, and extremely helpful, staff made the wait not seem so long! The owners were there greeting people and also stepped in to help their staff take orders and deliver food when needed. Their menu here has a ton of options which I loved! Even if you aren't a coffee drinker, they have lots of frappes, smoothies and other non coffee drinks. I got one of their speciality iced drinks, a Palomino, which was sweeter than something I would normally order but it was delicious! I also ordered a sandwich with raspberry mayo which wasn't as good as I expected it to be but the bread and toppings were all fresh and I still enjoyed it. Their food menu isn't as extensive as their drink menu, but they have a great list of breakfast, baked goods and lunch options to choose from! Also, their chips really sold me; idk what kind they are but they were fantastic!

I will definitely be back! This is a great new place that isn't far from home!

I don't usually ever write any reviews, but this place sucked. The owner of the place was very rude. He clearly was sexist. He was more respectful towards the guy customers over the girls. I left humiliated and disappointed.  Never coming back here again.
Our favorite Mexican restaurant. Great food, attentive servers and great meal for the money.
All the food was incredible. The best menu that has the most detailed pictures. Order all the soup dumplings if you can. A1.

We ordered the 10 bone baby back ribs, cheesy potatoes and fries. Ribs So tender, they fell off the bone. The tables had 6 different sauces for you to try.  There were so many fries we couldn't finish them. Great value! Great food!
This bakery is amazing! The atmosphere makes you feel like you're somewhere else in the world. Don't be fooled by the line, if there is one. It moves super quick and the items are priced fairly!
Dinner was very tasty, quality ingredients, friendly and efficient service.  Take out was a very good experience - so I am sure eat-in (whenever that happens again) would be excellant
